scope: Primary identities, README and license scopes inspected. Source code, benchmark performance, production security and medical suitability were not independently exercised. Reference tags are leads, not deployment approval.

0xCodez/iphone-mirror-windows.caution: README identifies the whole application as GPL-3.0 because it includes the playfair-derived FairPlay module. Network receiver, FFmpeg/Qt packaging, device control and further third-party license/security boundaries need independent review. Use only authorized devices and content.

799953468/frp-ban.caution: Regex/IP blocking can cause false positives and miss abuse; it is not authentication, patching, or comprehensive perimeter security.

addyosmani/agent-skills.caution: Individual skill installation may omit shared references. Compare the existing workflow and harness compatibility before adopting; no blanket installation or efficacy claim.

adventists-ai/sophon-realtime.caution: Voice/prosody claims and concurrency benchmarks are upstream, not independently reproduced; not clinical evidence. Code/weights claim Apache-2.0 but individual build/third-party model notices must travel with redistribution. Reported80GB GPU class is a substantial deployment constraint.

alexeyw/lot-map.caution: Visual activity is not correctness/progress proof; hook/log collection may reveal filenames or sensitive tool data.

Anil-matcha/open-genjutsu.caution: External generation credits and uploads; source/likeness/audio rights required; no public-hosting auth upstream.

anthropics/skills.caution: Per-folder licensing, no root license conclusion; office skills changed custom restrictions to Apache2 on Nov6 2026; preserve third-party terms; educational/demo disclaimer.

archid21/rightsize.caution: Savings/benchmarks upstream only, not reproduced; model/hook compatibility and spend controls need review.

bea4dev/shoji-bar-4.caution: Compositor/platform-specific system integration; not a portable generic frontend toolkit.

bomby-app/bomby.caution: README explicitly says permissions bypass/full computer access; not recommended deployment posture; MIT code excludes trademarks/branding; external voice/model costs.

cloudflare/security-audit-skill.caution: OS-enforced sandbox required before target-controlled execution per README; no audit run or vulnerability discovery claim.

Coolerwave/AimMac.caution: Input injection/pairing and ergonomics need validation; not assistive-device or safety certification.

djyde/dalibre.caution: No blanket top-level license established; README identifies GPL-3.0 calibre SQL plus OFL fonts/ISC icons/MIT colors. Writes to an existing calibre database require backup/compatibility validation.

Dodaios/ste80-humanizer.caution: Style transformation is not evidence of human authorship, correctness or STE certification; preserve meaning and citations. Third-party notices and source attribution require review.

ersinkoc/phonebox.caution: Pairing, notifications and local control increase device trust requirements; no security test performed.

expo/exact.caution: Not a drop-in React Native replacement without migration evaluation; compiler/host/toolchain requirements must be checked. NOTICE carves out vendor/media/font licenses; included permission for images is not blanket redistribution permission.

FutureMLS-Lab/FlashStates.caution: Reported latency improvements are workload/model/hardware-specific upstream benchmarks, not reproduced. Caching conversation/model state has privacy and cross-session isolation implications.

gokayfem/image-to-sculpt.caution: Unseen geometry is inferred/generated; image likeness and watertightness are not physical/manufacturing validity. Input images/model services/dependencies have separate terms.

google-deepmind/mujoco.caution: Simulation is not real-world/clinical validation; main tip may be unstable; third-party implot license.

GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance.caution: Code Apache-2.0 is not the entire license story: guides/ documentation is CC-BY-4.0 and derived documents have attribution requirements.

govijr/terminal-phone.caution: macOS/iOS pairing, terminal graphics and accessibility support constrain portability; physical-device permissions require review.

HybridRobotics/supermimic.caution: Do not transfer simulation claims to physical robot safety; GPU/dependency/training data terms need separate review.

jammaru/sakutto.caution: MIT covers project code, not PLaMo model weights: model Community License imposes separate commercial registration/eligibility terms. PLaMo Community License Article7.2 forbids using output as sole evidence/evaluation/opinion for medical diagnoses, legal matters, financial decisions or important personal assessments; redistribution, output attribution and derivative-model terms also apply. Wikipedia-derived benchmark fixture has CC-BY-SA-4.0 scope; third-party PDF/runtime notices apply. Local-processing claims are not an independently audited privacy guarantee.

JDhruv14/line-art-animation.caution: Check accessibility/reduced-motion and rendering cost in the actual product; no performance measurements reproduced.

JuneYaooo/rea-video.caution: Technique analysis does not grant rights to footage/music/likeness; authenticity judgments not verified.

Junhan2/ztd-charts.caution: Keyboard/screen-reader claims require testing with real target users and data; example values are fabricated upstream examples.

littledivy/tailnet-do.caution: Bridges a cloud runtime into private network trust; ACLs, egress, key lifecycle and Tailscale/Cloudflare terms need separate review.

mattpocock/skills.caution: Compare existing workflow before adopting; no blanket installation or efficacy claim.

milind-soni/OpenMausBot.caution: Apache-2.0 covers the core, excluding enterprise/. Enterprise production needs a key; third-party hosting, resale and white-labeling of enterprise features require a written partner agreement. Core-only use must exclude enterprise code and retain applicable notices and bundled licenses. Doctor-admin tags mean synthetic-data research, not healthcare approval.

Moh4696/cinematic-skill.caution: Research, image/music rights and factual checks remain producer responsibilities; generated output is not automatically cleared.

nishant-Tiwari24/cracked.caution: Company-specific advice and hiring outcomes are not independently verified; resume/personal data requires privacy review.

NVIDIA/auto-ontology.caution: Keep backend/ingestion private; ingestion has no own auth; optional Kumo table upload requires governance; human certification; no guaranteed retrieval completeness.

nwverse/persona.caution: Always-on hub and remote agent access expand authority; connected devices and secrets require independent security review.

NYLLON-SOFTWARE/ember-cloudflare.caution: Not Slack feature parity; cloud/model/service costs and data/access review required; nested Apache/MIT/ISC notices.

oddmundleikvoll/sprintwake-projects.caution: Everyone with project access can read draft-backed chat; private repo OAuth scope broad; macOS14+; no backend does not mean no external data.

OmniJev/Flide.caution: Published throughput/exactness claims depend on supported model/workload/hardware; not reproduced. Kernel provenance and model-weight licenses must be checked separately from root Apache-2.0.

paulirish/chrome-capture.caution: README targets Chrome153+ native recording and evolving automation support; verify installed versions before use. Recorded pages/audio may contain confidential information.

rauchg/vinyl.caution: Simulation/educational fidelity is not validated signal-accuracy; uploaded audio must be licensed. MIT covers the code, not all bundled recordings or generated cuts. README identifies Summer: Presto and its cut as CC BY-SA 4.0; preserve each recording's terms.

RUC-NLPIR/CoworkOS.caution: Persistent logs/connected desktop applications can expose confidential documents; reliability and recovery claims are not reproduced. THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES identifies bundled PPTist and bridge/local modifications under vendor/pptist with GNU AGPL-3.0 obligations. Application-wide distribution must not be described solely as MIT; fonts and external runtimes have further terms.

sherlock-project/sherlock.caution: Username matches are not proof of person identity; no unauthorized profiling or contact enrichment recommendation.

shinyobjectz/raea.caution: FSL-1.1-ALv2 restricts competing use; future Apache conversion is not current Apache permission. Source-available is not equivalent to unrestricted open source. README calls Windows newest/least tested and release young.

sshah03/recalc.caution: Early beta with expected bugs and breaking changes; keep independent backups before evaluating valuable spreadsheets. Cells can invoke shell commands or agents, crossing an execution boundary. Local-only/citation/lock claims are not a medical record, financial-control or security certification.

stevenmichaelthomas/numbrone.caution: Requires separate review of terminal workspace integration, shell authority, merge approvals and external-service access.

TIGER-AI-Lab/WebsiteBench.caution: Apache-2.0 code/task/verifier scope does not grant production reuse of third-party reference websites; README limits reference content to non-commercial research. Benchmark scores do not prove general production correctness or safety.

tobi/wrapvm.caution: No root LICENSE discovered: do not assume permission from public visibility or dependencies. Persistent browser sessions, workspace mounts, credentials and CDP exposure need threat modeling; VM is not automatically safe isolation.

Trendorin/yami.caution: OS/compositor-specific, not a generic application UI library. MIT code has separate bundled fonts; README identifies GPL-3.0 niri-derived component and branding restrictions.

tryatlas/atlas.caution: Redirect to tryatlas/atlas preserved; sensitive prompt/tool-output collection needs consent/redaction/retention review.

udhaykumarbala/cleanyourtv-app.caution: ADB/network debugging and app removal can disrupt a device; claimed restore safety is not independently validated. Third-party notices and bundled font licenses remain relevant.

vercel-labs/agent-browser.caution: Fresh refs after DOM/navigation; no anti-bot/auth bypass recommendation; bundled axe-core MPL2/third-party terms.

Z1Code/iCopy.caution: iCloud authentication and optional deletion are high-impact; no account access or deletion was tested. Do not generalize README verification claims to guaranteed recovery; independently prove restore before deletion.

zainudinnoori/gitmanual.caution: Generated setup/download scripts are untrusted suggestions; never execute merely because a guide produced them.

ZhuLinsen/daily_stock_analysis.caution: Not investment advice or accuracy proof; data/provider limits; screening subtree Apache2 while root MIT.
